function.name: Move turtle
function.description: Function to move the turtle using ROS command. Linear velocity parameters are described as (velx, vely, velz) and the angular velocities as (angx, angy, angz)
function.command: rostopic pub /turtle1/cmd_vel geometry_msgs/Twist -r 1 -- '[velx, vely, velz]' '[angx, angy, angz]'

function.name: Get position of the turtle
function.description: Function to retrieve the position of the turtle

function.name: Teleport turtle
function.description: Function to teleport turtle to a specified position.

function.name: Reset turtlesim
function.description: Function to reset the turtlesim environment. This will make the turtle go to its initial position
